description: The settings window, and the only surface that can write anything. It holds the two privileged commands: set_supervision persists a program that start_backend runs, and set_api_settings redirects the base URL every token-bearing request is built from. Since the 2026-10-18 security audit (F3) BOTH ask Windows Hello first, before anything is written: a host's token must not be repointed or a program persisted by a page alone. Turning supervision OFF alone does not ask (it only takes an ability away); a bind-address-only change does not ask either. It can also open a link in the real OS browser (About Jarvis's source link) - a single, narrow permission, not one of the two privileged ones above. And since 2026-10-10 it holds `open-fix-place`, so the 'Set up Jarvis' card's own 'Read the FAQ' can open the Brain on its 'Tutorials and the FAQ' tab: navigation only, it changes no setting and approves nothing. This window is created on demand and does not exist until the user opens it.
